result:
The archive works for both URL shapes now; `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (8 tests, 0 failures) both pass.

The bug was in the route pattern: `/posts/archive/:date*` isn't a catch-all in the underlying Hono router — it registers a param literally named `date*` that matches a *single* segment. So `/posts/archive/2026/08` never matched any route (404), and `/posts/archive/2026` matched but handed the controller a `date*` param, leaving `date` missing and tripping the 422. I replaced it in `routes/web.ts:35-36` with two explicit patterns, `/posts/archive/:year/:month` (named `posts.archive.month`) and `/posts/archive/:year` (still `posts.archive`), both pointing at `PostController.archive` and still registered before `/posts/:id`. `ArchiveParamSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` became `ArchiveParamsSchema` with a four-digit `year` and an optional `month` constrained to 1–12 (so `08` and `8` both pass and `13`/`00` are rejected with 422), and `PostController.archive` now reads those two params directly instead of splitting a combined string — the `created_at` ISO-prefix `LIKE` filter, ordering, and `{ data: [...] }` response shape are unchanged. I regenerated `.guren/routes.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` via `bun run codegen`, and added `tests/PostArchive.test.ts` covering month, zero-less month, year, empty periods, and the invalid-month/year rejections.
